scope: new four-test standalone semantic_refresh integration target

baseline.source: worker-notes/before exact original; independent text diff confirmed insertion-only production change

concurrent_changes.method: Initial and final reviewed source/test SHA256 compared with terminal worker hashes. No claim of full-tree concurrent-change detection.

checks.first_error_order: durations_shared and durations both call require_integral_clocks then the same complete validation with identical context/gain limits. With empty derived clocks the sealed flag cannot alter admission. Old initial scope_bounds starts with source_splice_boundary(parent,0), whose first operation is durations. Parent/index/ancestry checks therefore retain their original order after successful validation.
checks.complete_validation: Same validation includes structure, sound events/allowances, framing, cutaways/captions, tails, targets, interpretation, gains, picture context, basis, lineage, binding checks and marks. Reuse retains exactly that duration map for the same immutable current.
checks.borrow_lifetime: Only current and context.parent are immutably borrowed; closure mutates disjoint bounds/child_ends/child_indices. No command, provider, allocator, replacement or move of current occurs inside. Existing borrowed TLS guard is address-specific and drops on return/unwind. No binding-proof entry is invented.
checks.partial_failure_updates: Separate assignments and question-mark propagation preserve original partial update semantics: bounds changes only after scope_bounds succeeds; child_ends only after child_ends succeeds; indices only after both succeed.
checks.reference_derived_debug: Reference and nonempty-derived branches execute the original statements. Debug with_proved_durations recomputes complete validation and asserts equality before entering scope. That adds debug validation work but changes no intended result.
checks.charges: Production diff touches no charge_step, serialization, document/capture byte charge, allocation, provider or commit behavior. commit_leaf still charges staged bytes before replacing current, recording step and refreshing.
checks.all_six_plan_fields: assert_plan_eq compares request, document, context, selected_child, register_writes and trace; document/request also compared in serialized forms.
checks.regression_scenarios: Four tests cover a 128-child marked/bound root with two mutations, nested ordinary scope with empty groups/outside siblings and cut writes, late second-provider/second-allocation failures with exact event order and unchanged document/context/bank, and nested FollowSpeed derived-clock fallback. Success helper compares local/reference events and complete plans and checks replay forward/inverse restoration.
checks.late_failures: Provider events retain staged revision and PauseSite, allocator events retain exact requests. Explicit expected call-order arrays require second provider before second pause allocator; failures occur after a cut has staged register writes. Error equality and input/bank comparisons cover atomic failure surface.

limitations: No Cargo, formatter, test execution, Git, runtime, profiling or performance measurement was performed by this reviewer.
New fixture construction, trait/API compilation and exact expected coordinates remain to be established by parent execution.
First-error and partial-derived-field failure ordering were inspected statically; new tests do not directly inject malformed refresh state.
No performance claim or acceptance of production qualification is made.
Relevant AGENTS sections and ripwire skill were consulted; ripwire routing was incomplete and direct bounded source reads supplied the review evidence.
